responsibility: Implements MIR-based borrow checking and non-lexical lifetime analysis as a coordinated pipeline. The module renumbers MIR regions into inference variables, identifies universal regions, builds borrow inventories and place/path analyses, classifies defs and uses, maps MIR locations to analysis points, and gathers move, liveness, outlives, member, placeholder, and Polonius facts through MIR type checking and constraint generation. It stores and solves region constraints with graph- and SCC-based infrastructure, region-value representations, reverse-SCC queries, opaque-type remapping, and debugging dumps/graphviz output; computes borrow invalidation and place conflicts; and drives the final borrow-check query, including used-`mut` lint bookkeeping. Its diagnostics submodules then turn borrow, move, mutability, and lifetime failures into user-facing errors by finding explanatory uses, naming regions and variables, explaining why borrows must live, and suggesting outlives fixes.
